CITY OF ALHAMBRA DESIGN REVIEW BOARD
  ACTION MINUTES

  Regular Meeting
  April 8, 2025

  The audio recording of the meeting is available here: DRB Meeting – April 8, 2025 (Audio)

A.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER:  7:00 P.M. in Conference Room A of Alhambra City Hall.

B.  ROLL CALL:

  Present:  Anki Udani, Chairman; Nora Hernandez, Vice Chairman; Michael
  Daninger; Jennifer Ng

  Absent:  Stanley Tsai

  Staff Present: Steve Kuchenski, Secretary/City Architect, Eric Martinez, City Architect
  Representative

C.  CONSENT AGENDA:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 1:  MINUTES – March 25, 2025
  • Request: This is a request for the Design Review Board to approve
  the Minutes of the March 25, 2025, Regular Meeting of the Design
  Review Board.
  • Recommended Action: Design Review Board review and approve
  as submitted the Minutes of the March 25, 2025, Regular Meeting of
  the Design Review Board.

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve Consent Agenda Item 1.
  •  Moved by Board Member Michael Daninger, Seconded by Board
  Member Hernandez.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 4-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Tsai

D.  DISCUSSION ITEMS:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 2:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-25-017
  • 401 East Corto Street
  • Applicant: Valarie Gomez
  1
  04/08/2025
   •  Request: This is an application for a new playground canopy on an
  existing school property located in the rear and visible from the public
  right-of-way.
  •  Recommended Action: APPROVE - The proposed project is
  approved without conditions.

MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application without conditions
  •  Moved by Board Hernandez, Seconded by Board Member Ng.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 4-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Tsai

AGENDA
ITEM 3:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-24-143
  • 433 & 503 South Palm Avenue
  • Applicant: Juan Kivotos
  • Request: This is an application for exterior improvements on two
  existing industrial buildings, including new windows, doors,
  architectural canopy detail, and raised planter.
  • Recommended Action: APPROVE. The proposed project is
  approved without conditions.

MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application without conditions.
  •  Moved by Board Hernandez, Seconded by Board Member Daninger.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 3-1-0-1
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Daninger
  Noes:  Ng
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Tsai

AGENDA
ITEM 4:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB- 24-152
  • 2515 Aurora Terrace
  • Applicant: Anny Zapata
  • Request: This is an application for a new 468 SF 2nd unit on top of
  existing detached garage which will be converted into an ADU on a
  lot with an existing residential dwelling unit.
  • Recommended Action: APPROVE WITH CONDITIONS. The
  proposed project is approved with the following Conditions of
  Approval:

  2
  04/08/2025
   1) Provide a note on the plans that identifies the proposed window
  sill size, material, and color for all new windows.

MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application with the following Conditions of
  Approval:

  1) Provide a note on the plans that identifies the proposed window
  sill size, material, and color for all new windows.
  2) The applicant should place at least two (2) windows along the
  west elevation which adds detail to this blank wall.
  3) The applicant should place at least one (1) window along the east
  elevation which adds detail to this blank wall.
  4) Revise the elevation labels/names and north arrow on the site
  plan to show its correct orientation.
  5) Revise scuppers in elevation to bend inward and run along the
  building wall to rain barrels.
  6) Revise roof vent graphics to match the proposed vent product
  shown on material board.
  7) Show appropriate staircase post and/or supports at landing / mid-
  landing.

  •  Moved by Board Hernandez, Seconded by Board Member Daninger.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 4-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Tsai

AGENDA
ITEM 5:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-24-157
  • 2125 La Paloma Avenue
  • Applicant: Lori Pazula
  • Request: This is an application for a new 421 SF 1-story addition to
  the rear of an existing 1-story single-family residence.
  • Recommended Action: APPROVE. The proposed project is
  approved without conditions.

MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application with the following Conditions of
  Approval:

  1) Relocate one of the two new bathroom windows to the south wall
  and revise the elevations accordingly.
  2) Revise the two new windows on the north side of the addition to
  be equally sized and proportioned to each other.

  3
  04/08/2025
   •  Moved by Board Hernandez, Seconded by Board Member Ng.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 4-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Tsai

E.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS:

  •  There was Oral Communication for item #4, where Lori Pazula speaking as a
  member of the public asked if the project was allowed to construct an exterior
  staircase to separately access a second unit. City Architect Representative
  responded that this is a question for planning staff to respond to and not related to
  the design of the project.

F.  ADJOURNMENT:

  •  There being no other business, the meeting was adjourned at 8:01 P.M. to
  Tuesday, April 22, 2025, at 7:00 P.M.

  _____________________________
  Ankit Udani
  Chairman
ATTEST:

_______________________
Steve Kuchenski
Secretary/City Architect
